description: Discover genre-aware new releases or published OffStereo narrated shows. archive and search query only OffStereo stories, not YouTube, SoundCloud, or Internet Archive recordings. For original recordings, rare mixtapes, or DJ mixes, use external/provider media lookup first and make_playable with experience=media; do not default to an OffStereo archive search or a narrated story. Call exactly once per listener request: put every positive genre into the same genres array, use [] when none were requested, and avoid one call or card per genre. query carries the listener's full wording, exclusions, counts, and no-padding constraint. Results remain relevant rather than padding a requested genre or archive search with unrelated rows. Dated music-history requests use music_today and are not a discover mode. playableOnly limits results to music that plays in ChatGPT. allowBuild and allowSave preserve a read-only request. The result card already includes song playback; a separate one-song card is for an explicit request for a dedicated song card.

allowBuild.description: False preserves an explicit request not to create or build a story.

allowSave.description: False preserves an explicit request not to create or save anything.

genres.description: Every positively requested genre; [] when the request is not genre-filtered. Results do not pad with unrelated genres.

perGenreLimit.description: Maximum results from each named genre for a balanced new-release request.

playableOnly.description: True limits results to music with audio that plays inside ChatGPT.

query.description: OffStereo story query for archive/search, or the listener's release-discovery wording when it contains genres, balance, count, or no-padding constraints. Original recording and mixtape searches belong to make_playable experience=media with a provider or source URL.

type.description: Discovery mode. archive searches only published OffStereo narrated stories; search is its alias, not an external recording search. trending returns the pre-built fresh surface: the Friday Rundown, this week's records and today's anniversary, chart and news stories, every one already built and playable. Dated music-history requests use music_today.

name: discover

outputSchema.description: A discovery card. object is 'discovery' (new releases or music-today) or 'show_search' (archive/popular). Which section arrays are populated depends on the mode.

title: Discover music
